title: $1,000 in Costco in 2000 is now worth this
caption:
In 2000, Costco was a warehouse store.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:COST:2000-01-03} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Costco in 2000? 👇
sources: Costco price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In 2000, Costco was a warehouse store.
Say you put in one thousand dollars.
